       final isBackground = mode == OperatingMode.background;
       final cfg = settings.screenConfigNotifier.value;
       final spectrum = settings.settingsNotifier.value;
 
+      final isCassette = cfg is CassetteScreenConfig;
+      final cassetteCfg = isCassette ? cfg as CassetteScreenConfig : null;
+
+      final cassetteVariantSpec = isCassette
+          ? _Cycle(
+              'void-settings-cassette-variant',
+              'variant',
+              cassetteVariantMeta[cassetteCfg!.variant]!.label,

+                final next = CassetteVariant.values[
+                    (cassetteCfg!.variant.index + 1) %

+                settings.saveScreenConfig(cassetteCfg!.copyWith(variant: next));

+            )
+          : null;

+              .where((o) => !(o is _Cycle && o.id == 'void-settings-cassette-variant'))

       final rows = <Object>[

         _Group('MODE'),
         _Cycle('void-settings-mode', 'operating mode', mode.name,

         // ABOUT
         _Group('ABOUT'),
         _Cycle('void-settings-help', 'help', '>', () => HelpScreen.push(context)),
